SPARKLE AFRICA
We’re thrilled about the opportunity to host your groups at Radisson Blu Hotel, Nairobi Upper Hill. From
beautiful and great locations to our experienced team to support you at every step, we trust to have all the
capabilities to help you achieve your goals.
How we can help
The approriate venue for your Tour Series group:
Experience. We ensure that you’re provided with everything needed to make your stay a success.
Memorable. We want to delight your guest by creating memorable experiences, you can expect
modern bedrooms and personal touches during your stay.
Location. 10 minutes from Wilson Airport for flights to Maasai Mara, Mombasa, Mt. Kenya & 10
minutes from Jomo Kenyatta International Airport using the expressway
If you have questions or require further clarification, please, do not hesitate to get in touch with us. We are looking
forward to hosting your groups and welcoming you as our guests.
To confirm arrangements for SPARKLE AFRICA, please sign and return two copies of this agreement prior to
15/09/2026. After this date, if we are not in receipt of a signed Agreement, we reserve the right to release the rooms
being held for you and any Rooms booked will be subject to availability and Hotel’s Retail Rates. Should you have
any questions, please call the Hotel +254 709 810000. We are confident that our facilities will provide you with the
ideal site. We are committed to making your stay at Radisson Blu Hotel, Nairobi.

Corporate Rate:
Singles rooms for 4 or more nights.
Groups attending a conference/ Expo within the hotel or outside the hotel.
Seasons Dates Single Occupancy Rate Double Occupancy Rate
Yearly 01/01/27 to 31/12/27 USD 165 USD 193
Enhancements
• Parkview room = USD 20 per room
• Executive Room = USD 150 per room
• Classic welcome experience: USD 20 per person – cocktail, 1 alcoholic/ non-alcoholic drink and
selected snacks.
• Lunch Supplement Information (if applicable) USD 40 per person
• Dinner Supplement Information (if applicable) USD 45 per person
Check in, Early Arrival and Late Departures
• Check in time is at 1500 hrs.
• Complimentary early check in from 1300hrs upon room availability.
• Between 0800rs to 1300hrs we do charge a supplement of 60 USD
• Before 0800 hrs. we do charge the full room rate.
• Do note that our check out time is at 1200 hrs.
• Between 1300rs to 1800hrs we do charge a supplement of 60 USD
• After 1800 hrs. we do charge the full room rate
Room List
A rooming list, containing name of each participant of the group, the occupancy for each room (single, double, etc.)
must be received by the Hotel no later than 30 days prior to the group scheduled arrival date and special requests.
Complimentary bedrooms
Twin Room policy
The Hotel will grant discounts in respect of bona fide groups booked on the quoted Group rates as follows:
• 8 (eight) – 15 (fifteen) full paying twin rooms – 1 (one) complimentary person in a sharing room and
breakfast.
• 20 (twenty) – 39 (thirty–nine) full paying twin rooms – 1 (one) complimentary twin room and breakfast.
• 40 (Forty) – or more full paying twin rooms – 2 (two) complimentary Twin rooms and breakfast.
• The maximum number of complimentary rooms is 2 (two).
Single Room policy
The Hotel will grant discounts in respect of bona fide groups booked on the quoted Group rates as follows:
• 20 (twenty) – 39 (thirty–nine) full paying single rooms – 1 (one) complimentary single room and breakfast.
• 40 (Forty) – 59 (fifty-nine) full paying single rooms – 2 (two) complimentary single rooms and breakfast.
• 60 (sixty) – 79 (seventy-nine) or more full paying single rooms – 3 (three) complimentary single rooms and
breakfast.
• The maximum number of complimentary rooms is 3 (three).
Maximum bedroom occupancy
Three (3) Pax i.e. (2 adults 1 child).
Child policy
Children under age twelve (12) years old stay free of charge in an extra bed or cot while sharing the parent’s room
based on a maximum of one (1) child per room.
No Shows
No Show Charges apply for the entire stay, in an event the Agent doesn’t cancel the reservation.
Release Period & Cancellation Clause - Rooms
Until (90) days prior to the first scheduled arrival date, the whole, or part thereof, of the reservation may be cancelled
amended or postponed without a cancellation fee being charged.

Between (89) and (60) days prior to the first scheduled arrival date, (10%) of the number of rooms per night may be
cancelled, amended or postponed without cancellation fee. Any additional cancellations, amendments or
postponements will be charged, based on the contracted room rates. This reduction, amendment or postponement
of the room block cannot be cumulated with any following reductions, amendments or postponements.
Between (59) and (22) days prior to the first scheduled arrival date, (5%) of the initial number of rooms per night
may be cancelled, amended or postponed without cancellation fee. Any additional cancellations, amendments or
postponements. will be charged, based on the contracted room rates. Any additional cancellations, amendments or
postponements will be charged, based on the contracted room rates. This reduction of the room block cannot be
cumulated with any preceding or following reductions.
Less than (21) days prior to the first scheduled arrival date, any cancellations, amendments or postponements will
be subject to a cancellation fee equal (100%) of the contracted rate multiplied the number of cancelled, amended
or postponed room nights.
Check-in/Check-out
Check-in will be possible from 1400hrs local time on the day of arrival. In case of any arrival before this time, the
Hotel will do its utmost to have the room ready but does not guarantee this. Upon the Company’s or the individual
Agents’ prior request, early check-in can be agreed, subject to availability, pre-registration the previous night and
payment of an extra overnight charge at the agreed rate. The official checkout time is 1200hrs local time. A
supplementary charge may be required in the case of late checkout: half day rates apply for extensions up to
1800hrs local time and are subject to availability on the day.
Early Departure
If a Guest decides to leave the Hotel before the date of departure booked, cancellations fees are payable. The Hotel
shall have the right to charge these nights at the contracted rate until the date of departure originally booked.
Deposit and Payment Policy
The Tour Agent agrees to pay the Hotel the deposit(s) on date(s) as outlined below. The deposit(s) is/are to be
paid to Radisson Blu Hotel Nairobi, a company registered in Kenya with registered number C.96561, P.O. Box
21695 - 00100 City Square, Nairobi, Kenya. Referencing the name of the Tour Agent/Series if the deposit(s) is/are
not paid before the due date(s), the Hotel has the right to terminate the Contract by written notice to the Company
within thirty (30) working days from the due date. The Company shall in case of such termination be obliged to
compensate the Hotel and pay damages of no less than the amount of cancellations fees which would apply upon
cancellation of the event at that point in time prior to the event.
Payment
Upon confirmation of the Group, we will kindly request that full payment be made to us sixty days prior to the Group
arrival date;

Food & Beverage
No food or beverages will be allowed from outside other than the hotel. Alcoholic beverages are not permitted in
the hotel either by customer or any of his guests or invitees. The Hotel is not liable for and is indemnified against
claims for any health problems caused by consumption of food & beverage products brought into the hotel by the
client. We must receive a program with time schedules for meals and other services.
Competition
No competitor’s logos or advertisements to be exhibited without prior approval of the management. You may use
the hotel’s name or logo in announcements and displays, and use your own company name or logo in signs
displayed at the hotel, in both cases with written permission.
Liability
Each Party is liable to the other for its non-performance or undue performance under the Contract. The Hotel shall
however only be liable to the Company and/or any Agent in case of gross negligence or willful default of any person
being instructed and supervised by the Hotel.
The Company shall be severally and jointly liable for the Agents’ performance under the Contract, including
observation of their duty of care and timely payment of any invoiced amount in relation to the event. For the
avoidance of doubt, the Company shall be liable for payment of any amount outstanding by Agents for room charges
and cancellation fees, breakfast and extras, and in the case of no-shows.
Duty of Care
The Hotel represents to fully comply with all applicable local fire and safety regulations; the Hotel pursues regular
controls of its technical installations and customer protection processes to ensure highest safety and hygiene
standards. The Hotel undertakes to provide reasonable advance notification to the Company of any refurbishment
or renovation taking place at the Hotel’s property at the time of the event.
The Tour Agent may sell the HOTEL’s rooms for Leisure individual/Group travelers as room only or part of a
package to any Tour agent or tour operator pursuing off-line sales. The Tour Operator may also sell the rooms via
their own brochure(s) and/or catalogue(s). The Tour Agent/Operator shall confirm all sales of rooms and/or
cancellations and/or amendments directly with the HOTEL by email or fax. Room sales, amendments and or
cancellations will not be accepted by telephone.
The Tour Agent/Operator acknowledges acting on its own behalf when selling the HOTEL’s rooms and services at
Contracted Rates to any Leisure or individual traveler or third party and hereby warrants that it will perform its
obligations under this Agreement with promptness, due care, skill and diligence and in a workmanlike manner in
accordance with the highest industry standard.
Any Rooms contracted and sold to non-Leisure individual travelers or non-Leisure Group will amount to violation of
the contract terms and the Hotel’s will have the discretion to charge the Corporate rate and or the best available
rate for the Rooms sold to non-leisure guests upon written notice to the Tour Agent.
Force Majeure
In the event of a circumstance of “Force Majeure” which is defined as circumstances beyond the control of either
Party, such as any Act of God, fire, flood, meteorological perturbation, explosion, war, armed hostilities, act of
terrorism, riots, civil commotion, revolution, blockade, embargo, strike, government action, official or regulatory
intervention, either Party shall be entitled to suspend this Contract until such time when the circumstances
constituting Force Majeure have disappeared. The Company’s and any Agent’s reservation confirmed for the event
on a date within the period of Force Majeure may be cancelled by the Hotel by written notice to the Company. Each
Party shall nevertheless use its reasonable endeavors to alleviating the effects of such circumstances constituting
Force Majeure, including agreeing upon alternative arrangements.
If either Party becomes aware that any circumstances constituting Force Majeure have arisen or that any
circumstances which may constitute Force Majeure may arise, it shall immediately notify the other Party by
telephone and email.
Indemnity
The Hotel shall indemnify the Company in respect of any direct loss or damage only, including penalties, levies,
fines, expense, legal fees incurred by the Company where Hotel is liable and has caused such loss or damage by
its performance under the Contract. The Hotel will not be obliged to so indemnify the Company to the extent such
claim, cost, expense or damage results from negligence, willful misconduct or bad faith on the part of the Company
or any Agent(s) of the event.
